water.sampling_boundary: controller cumulative total at climate.ts; ledger deltas are assigned to the ending local day
water.reset_epoch: ledger detects reset, phantom zero and gap events; authenticated physical counter epoch is unavailable
water.daily_source_coverage: first and last raw samples within 10 minutes of local-day bounds, max raw gap 300 seconds, materializer through last raw sample, no missing interval or quality event
water.scientific_minimum_coverage: every analyzed local day must meet the source continuity rule; missing days remain null and in the randomized ITT denominator

electricity.sampling_boundary: HA last_updated is a gateway state timestamp; qualified samples integrate forward at most 300 seconds, without crossing an invalid poll or local-day bound
electricity.reset_epoch: no daily-reset energy counter is used; integrated power is bounded by source-qualified intervals
electricity.scientific_minimum_coverage: each analyzed local day must have fully source-qualified intervals; any missing day stays null in the randomized ITT row, and only complete matched pairs enter a resource contrast

runtime_model.status: burden diagnostic only; coefficient low/nominal/high values are not meter uncertainty

cost_policy: No cost or savings scalar until matching measured scopes and dated tariff inputs are locked; do not subtract partial measured electricity from a whole-runtime model or price absent gas/water inputs.
missing_policy: Missing, stale, reset-ambiguous and unmeasured values stay null; zero is an observed value only; no model imputation upgrades a measured endpoint.
claim_policy: No commissioned water, electricity, whole-resource, gas, DLI or cost endpoint in v1; the selected trial benefit remains nine_control_state_minutes with its heterogeneous-burden label.
